name: After § 3
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the enforcement of the Digital Markets Act
part_text: 3b. Warns that provisions in digital trade agreements – such as those restricting access to source code – may weaken the accountability mechanisms of the DMA; warns, in particular, that the extensive investigative powers granted to the Commission under the DMA, and the high level of scrutiny required, could be constrained by the limited exceptions in such agreements; calls, therefore, for the removal of all provisions in digital trade agreements that restrict access to source code, and for algorithmic accountability to be recognised and enforced as a core regulatory principle;
